name: Bicycle Sundays on the Bronx River Parkway
schedule: Select Sundays from May to October. 2026: May 3, 10, 17 and 31, 10 am to 2 pm; June 7, 14, 21 and 28 and July 12 and 26, 8 am to noon; Sept 13 and 20, 10 am to 2 pm; Oct 4, 10 am to 2 pm, the last day of the season. No dates in August. Canceled in rain.

start_location.name: Westchester County Center, East Lot (free parking; the parkway entrance is at Exit 22)

duration: Four hours (10 am to 2 pm in May, September and October; 8 am to noon in June and July)
founded_note: The county says the program has run since 1974.
visitor_notes: Free entry and free parking in the East Lot at the County Center. Everyone must be off the parkway by 1:50 pm in May, September and October, and by 11:50 am in June and July. Class 1 e-bikes only. No headphones. State law requires helmets for children under 14. Slower traffic keeps to the right lane. The county cancels in rain.
description: The county closes a 6.5-mile stretch of the Bronx River Parkway to cars on select Sundays, from Exit 22 at the Westchester County Center to Exit 4 at Scarsdale Road in Yonkers. Riders, scooters, skaters, walkers and joggers share the road, and the round trip is 13 miles. There is no led ride and nothing to sign up for.
evidence: The county's 2026 Bicycle Sundays page lists the season's Sundays from May 3 through Oct 4 and notes that Sept 27 was canceled for weather, so it was edited after that date (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The county posts one list of dates a year, May to October. The 2026 list ends Oct 4. Read the page again in April for the 2027 dates.

name: Bike Hoboken Community Ride
schedule: Monthly, on a Sunday, spring through fall: meet 10:45 am, roll 11:00 am. 2026 rides: Apr 26, May 31, Jun 28, Jul 26, Aug 30, Sep 20 and Oct 25. The start changes every month and is announced before each ride.

start_location.name: A different Hoboken park or plaza each month, announced on the Bike Hoboken events page

pace: Easy. Riders need to hold about 4 mph, a brisk jogging pace.
visitor_notes: No sign-up. Look for the Bike Hoboken banner and purple shirts. Riders must be on a bike, or in a child seat on an adult's bike, and wear a helmet. Hoboken police escort the group.
description: A family-friendly ride around Hoboken's square mile, once a month from spring through fall. It covers 3 to 5 miles with a stop or two, and every month starts somewhere new. The Hoboken police escort the group.
evidence: Bike Hoboken's events page lists its monthly community rides (Sun Aug 30, 2026: meet 10:45 am, roll 11 am), and Hudson County Complete Streets' calendar lists the Sept 20 ride and the next one, Sun Oct 25, 2026 at 11:00 am (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The county group's Squarespace event list gives each ride's start time (add ?format=json for the exact time). The start place is only in Bike Hoboken's own announcement.

name: Bike North Bergen / WeeBiken Community Ride
schedule: Monthly, on a Sunday, spring through fall: 10:30 am to 12:30 pm from Hamilton Park. 2026 rides: Apr 19, May 17, Jun 21, Jul 19, Sep 13 and Oct 11. A special ride to Summer Streets ran Aug 15.

host.name: Bike North Bergen / WeeBiken (Hudson County Complete Streets)

visitor_notes: The event page gives only the time and the start. It says "Join us for our 2026 North Hudson rides!" and nothing on route or pace, so check the county group's calendar before you go.
description: A monthly community ride for the North Hudson towns, starting at Hamilton Park in Weehawken. It runs two hours on a Sunday morning from spring through fall. The Bike North Bergen and WeeBiken groups run it with Hudson County Complete Streets.
evidence: Hudson County Complete Streets' events calendar lists the Sept 13, 2026 ride and the next one, Sun Oct 11, 2026, 10:30 am to 12:30 pm at Hamilton Park, Weehawken (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Squarespace event list. Add ?format=json for the exact start time of each ride. The Oct 2025 ride used the same slot, 10:30 am.

name: Thursday Night Training Ride
schedule: Thursdays. The ride leaves promptly at 4:45 pm on Oct 1, 4:30 pm on Oct 8 and 15, 4:15 pm on Oct 22 and 4:00 pm on Oct 29, earlier each week as the sun sets sooner. Back by dark.

host.name: Westchester Cycle Club (listed as an unaffiliated ride)

visitor_notes: The club's schedule marks this as an "unaffiliated ride": a member posts it and the club does not run it. Bring a light. The club asks riders to join ($40 a year). The page doesn't say whether guests can come to this ride, so use the Contact Leader link on the schedule first.
description: A fast after-work road ride from White Plains, about 33 miles at a 19 mph pace. A member posts it each Thursday on the Westchester Cycle Club schedule, with a route link and a cue sheet. The route changes through the series.
evidence: The Westchester Cycle Club ride schedule lists the Thursday Night Training Ride for Oct 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29, 2026, at 4:45, 4:30, 4:30, 4:15 and 4:00 pm from the Waller Ave. parking lot in White Plains (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The schedule lists about a month of rides. The start time drops each week through October. The page doesn't say when the series ends.

name: Women's Wednesday (WTFNB only), Central Park
schedule: Every Wednesday morning in Central Park, 6:50 to 8:00 am. Three laps at about 19 minutes a lap, 18 miles, B level, rotating paceline. Open to women, non-binary and trans riders only.

start_location.name: Central Park (the public ride page gives no meeting point)

pace: B level, 19-minute laps (about 19 mph), rotating paceline
visitor_notes: Open to all women, non-binary and trans riders. To join, sign in to the club's ride app. The page asks riders to become members and doesn't say whether a first ride is free.
description: A weekly dawn ride in Central Park for women, non-binary and trans riders, run by the New York Cycle Club. Three laps in a rotating paceline at B level. The club calls it a welcoming and fun ride.
evidence: NYCC's public ride app lists Women's Wednesday (WTFNB Only) for Wed Oct 7, 2026, 6:50 to 8:00 am in Central Park, and its summary says the ride runs every Wednesday morning (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's ride list loads without a login. Filter by ride type Central Park Laps and Wednesday.

name: Weekday Dawn Laps in Central Park (NYCC)
schedule: Monday to Thursday before work. Several groups start between 5:40 and 6:50 am, sorted by lap time. A-level laps at 5:40 am on Tuesdays and Thursdays, B-level laps at 6:05 am on Tuesdays and Thursdays, Recovery Laps on Mondays at 6:25 am, a slower C group on Thursdays at 6:45 am. Each ride is two to four laps, 12 to 24 miles.

start_location.name: Central Park (the public ride page gives no meeting point)

pace: Lap times from 16:00 (A, about 22 mph) to 29:00 (C, about 12 mph)
visitor_notes: Sign in to the club's ride app to join a ride. The page asks riders to become members and doesn't say whether a first ride is free. Pick the group by lap time. The club also runs Prospect Park laps on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
description: The New York Cycle Club's before-work laps of Central Park, Monday to Thursday. Groups start from 5:40 to 6:50 am and split by lap time, from fast A groups to a slow C group. Riders go two to four laps in a rotating paceline, in pacelines of fewer than ten.
evidence: NYCC's public ride app lists Central Park Laps groups for Thu Oct 1 and Mon Oct 5 to Thu Oct 8, 2026, from 5:40 to 6:50 am, with sign-ups open (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Filter by ride type Central Park Laps. Group names change; the weekday and early-morning pattern held across Oct 1 to 8.

name: Suffolk Bicycle Riders Association Club Rides
schedule: Several rides every Saturday and Sunday, plus weekday rides most days. Each ride's time, start, distance and class (AA to D) is posted on the club's upcoming rides list; the club also runs mountain bike rides in winter.

start_location.name: Varies by ride (county parks, train stations and bike shops across Suffolk County); the club keeps a start-locations list

pace: Classes AA (22+ mph) down to D (6–10 mph). C and D rides have a sweep and frequent stops.
visitor_notes: The club says its ride schedule is open to members and non-members. New riders usually start on a D ride. Bring a bike in good repair, a helmet, a spare tube or patch kit and water. The club meets at 7 pm on the first Thursday of the month in Centereach.
description: Long Island's biggest club posts several rides a day on its public list, from short, slow D rides to fast AA paceline rides. On Oct 1, 2026 the list had eight rides on Thursday alone. D rides are short, slow and made for beginners, and C and D rides are swept so nobody is left behind.
evidence: SBRA's upcoming rides list shows rides for Thu Oct 1 to Sun Oct 4, 2026, each with a leader, start, distance and class, and its new-rider page says the schedule is open to members and non-members (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Drupal list, two pages, newest rides first. Leader names are on the page and were left out here.

name: BTCNJ Club Rides
schedule: Rides most days, with the most on Saturdays and Sundays. Each ride's start time, place, pace, distance and level are on the club's public ride schedule. Rides set off 15 minutes after the listed time, after sign-in. Sign-up is required.

start_location.name: Varies by ride (often the Glen Rock Duck Pond, the Ridgewood Starbucks, Campgaw Mountain in Mahwah or a train station lot)

pace: Levels A to D, with B* and C* in between. Each ride lists its level.

host.name: Bicycle Touring Club of North Jersey (BTCNJ)

cost: Membership is $25 a year; a free one-month trial is available on request
visitor_notes: Members only. The schedule page says you must be a member and sign up for each ride, and to ask the club about a free one-month trial. Helmets are required. Only Class 1 e-bikes are allowed. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian in the membership.
description: A Bergen County club that posted 28 rides in a 31-day stretch this fall, from 8-mile C rides to a 100-mile century. Rides start at commuter lots, parks and coffee shops across Bergen, Passaic, Essex and Morris counties, and sometimes in Rockland County, New York.
evidence: BTCNJ's public ride schedule lists 28 rides from Thu Oct 1 to Sat Oct 17, 2026, with start times, places and levels (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The public page shows about a month of rides. Leader names are on it and were left out here.

name: Crack o' Dawn Friday Frolic (BTCNJ)
schedule: Fridays, meet 6:00 am, wheels down at 6:05 am. The leader calls it the weekly start of the weekend ride. Does not go in rain or on wet roads.
pace: B* level, a relaxed pace on rolling roads (about 1,000 feet of climbing)

host.name: Bicycle Touring Club of North Jersey (BTCNJ)

cost: Membership is $25 a year; a free one-month trial is available on request
visitor_notes: BTCNJ members only; ask the club about the free one-month trial. Sign-up is required. The leader suggests coffee after the ride at Ridgewood Coffee or Tatte.
description: A weekly early-morning ride from the Ridgewood Starbucks: about 21 miles of rolling roads up Saddle River Road toward Monsey and back, then coffee. The leader calls it a nice, relaxed pace.
evidence: BTCNJ's public ride schedule lists the Crack o' Dawn Friday Frolic for Fri Oct 2, 2026 at 6:00 am from the Ridgewood Starbucks, and the leader's note calls it the weekly start of the weekend ride; only that one date was posted (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Leaders post each Friday's ride a few days ahead, so later Fridays may not show yet.

name: Montclair Cyclists Sunday Ride (Montclair Bikery)
schedule: Sundays at 8:00 am from the shop, per the shop's own calendar, which repeats the ride every Sunday and Saturday with no end date. In 2025 the same entry moved to 7:00 am from June to October.
visitor_notes: Calendar only. The shop's group-rides page lists a Friday ladies ride and a Saturday ride, not a Sunday ride, so call or ask in the shop before you go. The shop says rides are suspended for wet roads or temperatures below freezing.
description: A Sunday-morning road ride from the Montclair Bikery on Valley Road. It shows on the shop's own calendar as the Montclair Cyclists Ride, every Sunday at 8:00 am. The shop's rides page doesn't mention it.
evidence: The shop's public Google calendar repeats a Montclair Cyclists Ride every Sunday and Saturday at 8:00 am from 148 Valley Rd with no end date; the entry was last edited Nov 20, 2025, and the shop's rides page doesn't list a Sunday ride (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Google calendar behind the shop's calendar page. The page says April to October; the calendar has no end date.

name: Morris Area Freewheelers Club Rides
schedule: Several rides a day, posted by ride leaders. On the Oct 1 and 2, 2026 list the weekday rides went off mid-morning and the Oct 4 Sunday rides went off around nine. Each ride lists its own start, pace, distance and climbing. Check back within two hours of the start for changes.

start_location.name: Varies by ride (Denville, Bedminster, Bridgewater's Duke Island Park, Readington, Far Hills); the club keeps a start-points list

pace: Rated by pace and terrain, from D+ to B on the Oct 1 to 4 list
visitor_notes: The schedule page says you can sign up as a guest for one ride, then you should join the club. Sign up for each ride on the schedule page.
description: A Morris County club whose leaders post several rides a day, with starts across Morris, Somerset and Hunterdon counties. On Oct 1, 2026 four rides left at 10 am, and five Biketoberfest rides on Sunday Oct 4 were shared with BTCNJ. Pace groups run from D+ to B.
evidence: MAF's ride schedule lists rides for Thu Oct 1 to Sun Oct 4, 2026, each with a sign-up and a status, and says a visitor can sign up as a guest for one ride (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: WordPress schedule table. The 7-day page loads later days by script. Leader names and phone numbers are on it and were left out here.

name: Westchester Social Cyclists Rides
schedule: Most Tuesdays at 8:15 am and most Saturdays between 8:30 and 9:30 am, with the odd Friday. Each ride is posted on Meetup a week or two ahead. Recent Tuesdays: Sept 29, Oct 6 and Oct 13.

start_location.name: Posted for Meetup members. Many rides start in Hastings-on-Hudson; others start at Farragut, Briarcliff Manor or Seven Lakes Drive

visitor_notes: The public Meetup list shows each ride's date, time and route title only, for example "Hastings to Croton Reservoir and Tazza Cafe". The start, pace and distance are visible to group members only.
description: A Meetup group that runs road rides in southern Westchester, mostly on Tuesday mornings and Saturdays. Titles on the list name the route, such as Hastings to Briarcliff Manor or a loop out to Seven Lakes Drive. Join the group to see the starts.
evidence: The group's Meetup events page lists rides on Tue Sept 29, Fri Oct 2, Tue Oct 6, Sat Oct 10 and Tue Oct 13, 2026 (Tuesdays 8:15 am, Saturdays 8:30 to 9:15 am); details are for members only (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: A script got a 403 from the ICS feed on Oct 1. The events page carries dates and titles in its page data.

name: Saturday Morning C Ride (Cycle Craft)
schedule: Saturdays at 8:00 am from the shop, most weeks. Listed for Sept 12, Sept 19 and Oct 3, 2026. C pace, 15 to 16 mph.
visitor_notes: Sign-up and details are on the shop's Meetup group, which the shop's home page links as its rides and events.
description: A Saturday-morning road ride from the Cycle Craft shop on Route 46 in Parsippany, at a 15 to 16 mph C pace. The shop posts it on its Meetup group, which has about 2,000 members.
evidence: Cycle Craft's Meetup group lists the Saturday Morning "C" Ride at 8:00 am from Cycle Craft Parsippany on Sept 12, Sept 19 and Oct 3, 2026, and the shop's home page links the group as its rides and events (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Nothing was posted for Sept 26. Rides go up a couple of weeks ahead.

name: Saturday Mountain Bike Ride at Mahlon Dickerson (Cycle Craft)
schedule: Every Saturday at 9:00 am, posted weekly through January 2027. Intermediate terrain.

start_location.name: Mahlon Dickerson Reservation, Saffin Pond lot

visitor_notes: Sign-up and details are on the shop's Meetup group.
description: A weekly Saturday-morning mountain bike ride at Mahlon Dickerson Reservation in Jefferson, on intermediate terrain. Cycle Craft in Parsippany posts it on its Meetup group, and the dates run on through January.
evidence: Cycle Craft's Meetup group lists the Jefferson/Mahlon Saturday Morning Intermediate Terrain Mountain Bike Ride at 9:00 am on Sept 26, Oct 3 and every Saturday after, through January 2027 (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Same Meetup group as the shop's Saturday road ride. The recurring series is posted months ahead.

name: Bethpage Introductory Ride (CLIMB)
schedule: First Sunday of the month at 8:45 am at the Bethpage State Park playground. 2026: Jun 7, Jul 5, Aug 2, Sep 6 and Oct 4 (the October ride is the Retro Bike Ride).

start_location.name: Bethpage State Park playground
start_location.address: Bethpage State Park, Old Bethpage, NY

visitor_notes: The Meetup title calls it an introductory ride. The public list gives no pace or distance, so ask the group before you go.
description: CLIMB's monthly introductory mountain bike ride at Bethpage State Park, on the first Sunday of the month. The group runs trail work and rides across Long Island and has more than 800 members on Meetup.
evidence: CLIMB's Meetup group lists a Bethpage Introductory Ride at 8:45 am on the first Sunday of each month, Jun 7 through Sep 6, 2026, and the next one on Sun Oct 4, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The list starts at May 31, so earlier months and the winter schedule are unknown.

name: CLIMB Group Ride & BBQ
schedule: Monthly at 10:00 am, usually the last Sunday: May 31, Jul 26, Aug 30 and Sep 27, 2026. It alternates between the Glacier Ridge Bike Trail in Farmingville and Hidden Pond Park in Hauppauge. No date posted yet for October.

start_location.name: Glacier Ridge Bike Trail, Farmingville (alternates with Hidden Pond Park, 660 Terry Rd, Hauppauge)

visitor_notes: The Meetup event names the trail each month. The public list gives no pace or distance.
description: CLIMB's monthly mountain bike group ride with a barbecue, alternating between the Glacier Ridge trail in Farmingville and Hidden Pond Park in Hauppauge. It runs at 10:00 am on a Sunday near the end of the month.
evidence: CLIMB's Meetup group lists Group Ride & BBQ events at 10:00 am on May 31, Jul 26, Aug 30 and Sep 27, 2026; nothing is posted for October yet (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: June had a Glacier 8 intermediate and advanced ride on Jun 14 instead. The Long Island Mountain Bike Festival is Oct 17.

name: NYC-ADV Saturday Adventure Rides
schedule: Saturday mornings, about every other week from May to fall, at 8:00 am. Season 11 so far: May 9, May 16, May 30, Jun 6, Aug 15, Aug 29 and Oct 10. Each ride is a new park.

start_location.name: Different each ride: state parks in New York and New Jersey (Oct 10 is Harriman Tiorati Plateau)

visitor_notes: Each ride is its own Meetup event with its own start. The club's monthly mixer on the first Thursday at 7 pm is a social, not a ride.
description: A Brooklyn-based Meetup group that rides to a different state park most Saturdays, such as Fahnestock, Croton Point, Voorhees, Mohonk, Bass River and Harriman. Rides are numbered by episode, and season 11 is on episode 8 for Oct 10.
evidence: The group's Meetup page lists Season 11 episodes at 8:00 am on Saturdays May 16 through Oct 10, 2026, the latest held Aug 29 and the next on Oct 10 (read Oct 1, 2026).
